description: This file defines UI theme-related constants and a composable function for applying a custom theme in a Jetpack Compose Android app. It specifies color schemes, shapes, and typography styles, and provides 'OceanProfessionalTheme' as a wrapper for theming content.

classes.name: Shapes
classes.description: Defines corner shapes used in the theme, setting different radii for size categories.

classes.name: AppTypography
classes.description: Defines the typography styles used in the theme, currently using default settings.

methods.name: OceanProfessionalTheme
methods.description: A composable function that applies the custom color scheme, shapes, and typography to the MaterialTheme for its content.
